description: Use this when the user wants a bill payment calendar, a bill tracker printable, a monthly bill calendar, bill reminders, or to know which paycheck pays which bill. Put each bill into bills (name, amount, due_day or due_date, frequency, autopay) and pay into paychecks (amount, frequency, first_date); convert a pasted list or a screenshot into those fields, and use bills_text only as a fallback. Returns a printable calendar PDF for 1 to 12 months with bills on their due days and month totals, an ICS file with one reminder per bill (2 days before by default), and an Excel plan that assigns each bill to the last paycheck on or before its due date with the money left. Bills due on the 29th to 31st move to the last day of shorter months; weekend_rule can move weekend due dates. Does not pay bills, connect to banks, or know bank holidays.

amount.description: Amount due, e.g. 1500 or "$89.99". Leave empty if it varies; it then shows without an amount.

anchor_date.description: For weekly, biweekly or every-4-weeks bills: one due date to count from, e.g. "2026-11-06".

autopay.description: true if it is paid automatically, e.g. true or "yes". Default false.

due_date.description: A date it is due, e.g. "2026-12-15". Needed for quarterly, every-6-months, yearly and one-time bills; for monthly bills the day of the month is used.

due_day.description: Day of the month it is due, 1 to 31 or "last", e.g. 31 (moves to the last day in shorter months).

frequency.description: monthly (default), weekly, biweekly (every 2 weeks), every 4 weeks, semimonthly (twice a month), quarterly, semiannual, yearly or once.

name.description: Bill name, any language, e.g. "Rent" or "Car insurance".

second_day.description: For semimonthly bills: the second due day, e.g. 15 or "last".

bills.description: The bills as objects: [{"name":"Rent","amount":1500,"due_day":1},{"name":"Phone","amount":65,"due_day":31,"autopay":true},{"name":"Car insurance","amount":420,"frequency":"quarterly","due_date":"2026-12-15"}]. Convert a pasted list or a screenshot into these fields. Up to 60 bills.

bills_text.description: Fallback only: bills pasted as text, one per line, e.g. "Rent 1500 on the 1st\nPhone 65 on the 31st autopay". Prefer bills.

currency.description: Optional currency, e.g. "USD", "GBP", "€". Default: from the amounts, else no symbol.

date_order.description: Optional order for dates like 03/04/2026: "mdy" (US, default) or "dmy".

include_paydays.description: Add paydays to the ICS file as events without alarms. Default true.

amount.description: Take-home amount of one paycheck, e.g. 2100 or "$2,100.00".

day.description: Monthly or semimonthly pay day, e.g. 15 or "last".

first_date.description: One real pay date to count from, e.g. "2026-11-06". Needed for weekly and biweekly.

first_paycheck.description: true only when first_date is the very first paycheck (a new job). Default false: earlier pay dates on the same schedule are counted.

frequency.description: biweekly (default), weekly, semimonthly (twice a month) or monthly.

second_day.description: Semimonthly second pay day, e.g. "last" (default with day 15).

first_date.description: One real pay date to count from, e.g. "2026-11-06". Needed for weekly and biweekly.

first_paycheck.description: true only when first_date is the very first paycheck (a new job). Default false: earlier pay dates on the same schedule are counted.

frequency.description: biweekly (default), weekly, semimonthly (twice a month) or monthly.

second_day.description: Semimonthly second pay day, e.g. "last" (default with day 15).

paychecks.description: Optional paychecks: [{"amount":2100,"frequency":"biweekly","first_date":"2026-11-06"}]. With paychecks the plan shows which paycheck pays which bill and the money left.

reminder_days_before.description: Days before the due date for the calendar reminder, 0 to 30. Default 2.

reminder_time.description: Time of day for the reminder, e.g. "09:00" (default) or "8am".

start_month.description: First month, e.g. "2026-11" or "November 2026". Default: this month.

starting_balance.description: Optional money in the account before the first paycheck in the plan, e.g. 600 (negative such as -200 when overdrawn). Pays the bills that fall before the first paycheck and shows the lowest point.

title.description: Optional title printed on each page, e.g. "Household bills".

weekend_rule.description: Optional: "previous_business_day" moves a Saturday or Sunday due date to the Friday before; "next_business_day" to the Monday after. Default: "none".

name: generate_bill_calendar
title: Generate bill calendar
